_about: The order in which existing identification pages are rebuilt to the photo-ID formula (owner, Oct 16, 2026: act now, additive only). How to rebuild one: data/god-build/RETROFIT_BRIEF.md. Tier 1 = pages with measured striking-distance demand, by score; tier 2 = identification guides with no Search Console data yet (released Oct 7-16, before the formula), by the format hit rates in data/god-build/bettertermite-teardown.md.
source: Google Search Console API, sc-domain:buzzskito.ca, web search, dataState all; page dimension for totals, page+query for the position mix (multi-dimension pulls drop rows, so use those for ranking, not totals).
method: Per page and per window: impressions at positions 4-20 (page+query rows whose position rounds to 4-20) per month; gain = those impressions x (top-3 click-through - their current click-through) at 2.5% / 4% / 6% (low / mid / high, the same rates as path-to-50k.md table 1b). score = mean of the mid gain over 90 days and over 28 days, so a page needs demand both across the season and now. It is a ceiling (every query reaching the top 3); plan on 30-50% of it.

fields.kind: tsx = hand-written article (app/blog/<slug>/page.tsx); json = guide (content/guides/<slug>.json, rendered by components/GuidePage.tsx)
fields.type: bites | signs | life-stage | look-alikes | x-vs-y | bugs-in-a-place | id | species-name (a page whose searches are the pest's name, usually a control page)
fields.titleNow: the rendered <title> from the last full build (Oct 15, 23:40)
fields.inboundLinks: distinct pages linking to it in that build (pages released Oct 16 are not counted)
fields.oct15_16: TSX only: photos added Oct 15 or 16 (sitemap dated sets) and whether META_TITLE changed since Oct 15 (git)
fields.formulaGaps: what the page lacks against the formula
fields.linkInCandidates: topically close live articles that do not link to it yet, strongest first (input for the link-in agent, data/god-build/LINK_IN_BRIEF.md); judge each by hand

exclusions: Not listed: service, city, quote and pricing pages; product-review / affiliate "best X" pages (titles only at most); the 33 lead posts (lib/page-roles.json); question and control pages whose searches are not identification. The biggest of those are in excludedHighGain with the reason.
